{{Quote|Our scout ships have reached Dantooine. They found the remains of a Rebel base, but they estimate that it has been deserted for some time.|[[Siward Cass/Legends|Siward Cass]]|audio=Cass-ANH.flac|<ref name="ANH">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
A '''decoy base''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in order to lure the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] away from its [[Dantooine base/Legends|main base]] on the planet.

==History==
{{Quote|We have re-established this emergency base after the Empire located our decoy base on the other side of Dantooine.|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], about the [[Dantooine base/Legends|Dantooine base]]|<ref name="SWG:CA" />}}
The decoy base was one of the two bases built by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on Dantooine<ref name="SWG:CA" /> in the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ANH" /> Its role was to lure the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] away from the [[Dantooine base/Legends|main Rebel base]] on the other side of the planet.<ref name="SWG:CA" />

[[File:DantooineRebelBase.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The [[Dantooine base/Legends|real Rebel base]] on Dantooine that the decoy base protected.]]
At the time of the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] revealed the presence of the Rebels on Dantooine. The Empire immediately dispatched [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ships to investigate the Rebel presence on Dantooine.<ref name="ANH" /> The Imperial survey team discovered the decoy base<ref name="SWG:CA" /> and estimated that the base had been deserted for a long time, possibly years.<ref name="ANH" /> The discovery of the decoy base allowed the real Rebel base to remain undetected, although it was soon evacuated by the Rebels as a safety precaution.<ref name="SWG:CA" /> In the following months, the news of the discovery of a Rebel base on Dantooine widely spread in the galaxy. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself briefly visited the decoy base during his search for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] but found nothing of interest.<ref name="GoF:Clones">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Clones]]''</ref> As the Empire considered the Rebellion had abandoned Dantooine, the Rebels could return safely to Dantooine after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and reuse their main base on the planet.<ref name="SWG:CA" />

During the months following the Battle of Yavin, a mysterious and ancient [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-corrupted [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility located in the nearby ruins<ref name="GoF:Clones" /> of the [[Jedi Enclave]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> began the creation of clones. As the machine replicated the appearance and partial memories of original individuals, the clones assumed the identity of Rebel personnel previously stationed on Dantooine and occupied the compound. They appeared to maintain operations in the base, even constructing a new starship within the hangar.<ref name="GoF:Clones" />

Months after the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel sympathizers [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] and [[Mammon Hoole]] visited the abandoned base on Dantooine during one of their adventures. They initially believed the inhabitants to be allies as the latter claimed to be Rebel survivors. However, suspicion grew as Hoole uncovered mismatched records, duplicates of individuals, and behavior inconsistent with true Rebels. In addition, they realized that their vessel was little more than a crude and dysfunctional structure, incapable of spaceflight. The three adventurers finally discovered that the inhabitants of the base were clones fabricated by a dark side machinery in the nearby ruins. Their purpose was not aligned with the Rebellion's ideals but with the will of the ruins' corrupt energy, which sought to lure and entrap outsiders. Hoole and the Arranda siblings eventually escaped the planet Dantooine after destroying the cloning chamber and many of the clones.<ref name="GoF:Clones" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dantooine decoy base was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The game established that the Rebel base discovered by the Empire on Dantooine in {{Film|IV}} was in fact not the real base but a decoy intended to lure the Empire away.<ref name="SWG:CA" />
